tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me. Let’s start with something simple. Have you ever traveled to another country? What did you learn from that experience?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你今天抽空交流。我们先从简单的问题开始吧。你去过其他国家旅行吗？从那次经历中你学到了什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Great. Now, let’s think about social behavior.Do you think it’s easy or difficult to make friends with people from other cultures? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：很好。现在我们来聊聊社交行为。你认为和不同文化背景的人交朋友容易吗？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thanks. Here’s another question.Movies, books, and TV shows often show different parts of the world.Do you think these media help people understand other cultures? Why or why not?
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢。再问一个问题。电影、书籍和电视节目常常展现世界的不同风貌。你觉得这些媒体有助于人们了解其他文化吗？为什么有助于或无助于？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Last question.Some people think speaking the local language is the best way to learn about a culture. Do you agree? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：最后一个问题。有人认为，说当地的语言是了解一种文化的最佳方式。你同意这种说法吗？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview
